title: Iron Elevators Bukkit
description: Iron Elevators is a Plugin made by Me that adds custom Iron elevators to the game.
body:
A lightweight Bukkit/Paper plugin that adds special iron elevator blocks. Jump to go up, sneak to go down, configure the elevator distance. Normal iron blocks remain untouched and can still be crafted normally.

## Commands

`/elevator`
Shows the main IronElevator help menu.

`/elevator item [amount]`
Gives you special Elevator Blocks.

Example:
`/elevator item 64`

`/elevatoritem [amount]`
Direct command to get special Elevator Blocks.

Example:
`/elevatoritem 64`

`/elevator distance <number>`
Changes the maximum vertical distance between elevator blocks.

Example:
`/elevator distance 256`

`/elevator mark`
Marks the iron block you are looking at as an Elevator Block.

`/elevator reload`
Reloads the plugin configuration.

## Alias

`/ie`
Alias for `/elevator`.

Examples:
`/ie item 64`
`/ie distance 256`

## Permissions

`ironelevator.give`
Allows players to receive Elevator Blocks.
Default: OP

`ironelevator.admin`
Allows players to change settings, reload the plugin, and mark blocks as elevators.
Default: OP
